# 📚 StudySathi

**AI-powered Study Companion** — Upload notes, get summaries, flashcards, and quizzes generated by AI.

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Runtime | Node.js v20 |
| Framework | Express.js |
| Database | MongoDB (Mongoose ODM) |
| File Storage | Firebase Storage |
| AI | Groq (Llama 3.3 70B) |
| Auth | JWT + bcryptjs |

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Go to backend
cd backend

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install

# 3. Configure environment
cp .env.example .env
# Fill in your MongoDB URI, Firebase creds, Groq API key, and JWT secret

# 4. Start development server
npm run dev
```

Server runs at `http://localhost:5000`. Hit `/api/health` to verify.

## API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/auth/signup` | ❌ | Create account |
| POST | `/api/auth/login` | ❌ | Login |
| GET | `/api/auth/profile` | ✅ | Get user profile |
| PUT | `/api/auth/profile` | ✅ | Update name/bio/avatar |
| PUT | `/api/auth/profile/password` | ✅ | Change password |
| POST | `/api/study/upload` | ✅ | Upload note (file/text) |
| GET | `/api/study/notes` | ✅ | List notes (paginated) |
| GET | `/api/study/notes/:id` | ✅ | Get single note |
| POST | `/api/ai/summarize` | ✅ | Generate summary |
| POST | `/api/ai/flashcards` | ✅ | Generate flashcards |
| POST | `/api/ai/quiz` | ✅ | Generate quiz |
| GET | `/api/ai/result/:id` | ✅ | Poll AI result |
| GET | `/api/ai/results/note/:noteId` | ✅ | All results for note |
| GET | `/api/progress` | ✅ | Get study stats |
| POST | `/api/progress/update` | ✅ | Update study stats |

## Architecture

Modular monolith with clean layering:

```
Routes → Controllers → Services → Repositories → MongoDB
```
